name: design-system-kit
description: Figma plugin that generates a complete design system: color, type, spacing, radius and elevation tokens, Figma styles and variables, 50 components, and token export to CSS, Tailwind and DTCG.
author: Tejas V Krishna

scripts.watch: vite build --watch --mode development --config vite.ui.config.ts & vite build --watch --mode development --config vite.config.ts
scripts.build: vite build --config vite.ui.config.ts && vite build --config vite.config.ts
